# Design DNA in GitHub Copilot

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/copilot.json -->

## Install

### Copilot CLI, VS Code agent mode, JetBrains, Copilot app: skill folder

Method: skill folder. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna && cd design-dna
python install.py install --target copilot            # user scope: ~/.copilot/skills/reverse-design
python install.py install --target copilot --scope project --project <your project>   # .github/skills/reverse-design
```

Add `--dry-run` to see the changes first. The installer also runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` (skip with `--no-deps`). Without the installer, unzip [design-dna-skill.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-skill.zip) into `~/.copilot/skills/`.

### Copilot CLI plugin (Agent Plugins 1.0 package)

Method: plugin / extension. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

1. python install.py install --target copilot --method plugin
2. This builds a local marketplace at ~/design-dna/hosts/copilot-marketplace and, when copilot is on PATH, runs: copilot plugin marketplace add <that folder>, then copilot plugin install design-dna@design-dna-local
3. VS Code lists plugins installed by the Copilot CLI under Agent Plugins - Installed.

Package: [design-dna-agent-plugin.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-agent-plugin.zip) (or `python install.py package --target agent-plugin`).

### Copilot cloud agent and code review (repository skills)

Method: skill folder. Capability: **Hosted code sandbox**. The scripts run in the vendor's container. Which packages and browsers it has is not documented for this skill and was not tested; scripts/capabilities.py reports it at the start of a chat. Files do not outlive the sandbox, so download exported bundles.

1. python install.py install --target copilot --scope project --project <your repo>  (writes .github/skills/reverse-design)
2. Commit the folder. The cloud agent reads repository skills.

## Where the host looks

| Scope | Folders this host reads (from its documentation) |
|---|---|
| user | `~/.copilot/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.claude/skills` |
| project | `.github/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.agents/skills` |

If two of these folders hold `reverse-design`, the host picks one by its own precedence rules. `python install.py doctor --target copilot` lists every copy it can see.

## Prerequisites

- A GitHub Copilot plan
- Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine on local surfaces

## Check, update, remove

```bash
python install.py doctor --target copilot      # Python, packages, Chromium, store, visible copies
python install.py update --target copilot      # refresh from this checkout (git pull first)
python install.py uninstall --target copilot   # only unmodified copies it installed; templates are kept
```

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
